title: Debugging
summary: Step through a program, trace what it does, watch the network and the disk.
consent: These tools can read any process's memory and every packet on the box. Install them only while you need them: they are removed again after the time you choose.
notes: perf is built for Debian's kernel; on a vendor kernel parts of it may not work (on a Luckfox Lyra's 6.1 kernel it reports 6.12 and runs).

bpftrace, bcc (bpfcc-tools) and bpftool come only on 64-bit boards: a 32-bit ARM kernel will not load their programs (a Luckfox Lyra's did not). Where they come, they need the kernel's BTF (/sys/kernel/btf/vmlinux) or its headers.
Core dumps are collected while the kit is installed (systemd-coredump); its other services stay stopped.
